name: cordis-plugin-novelist
description: File-ledger domain tools for long-form fiction production on DSH (deepseek-harness): 12 deterministic novel_* tools over a plain-file book ledger (project/bible/characters/foreshadows/timeline/outline/manuscript/status/events + editorial event-tape + scores.jsonl with evidence substring verification). v7.0 three semantic primitives (novel_ask / novel_chapter derive mode / novel_decide); v7.4 ruling revocation (supersedes, append-only) + batch-review aggregation instrument (instruments/batch-aggregate.mjs: quote-locating, paragraph clustering, k-vote escalation, single-report blind-store). v0.8.0 adds an MCP server (mcp/: same 12 tools for any MCP client — Claude Code/ZCode/Cursor — with workspace-root path safety as a hard boot prerequisite) and a public starter editorial preset (preset-starter/: two-seat newsroom with editor-in-chief + author personas, anti-self-ratification deny lists, blind-reader input isolation) — code does the accounting, the model does the writing.
